title: Compact-source endpoint third-moment bridge under the source-uniform onsite split
question: Does the registered source-uniform onsite split k_(x,h)>=1+gamma|q_x|^4, together with the closed compact-source fifth moment, give a volume- and source-uniform endpoint third moment for the projected D,delta-D force interface?

model.onsite_split: In the registered finite periodic compact-source family, H_Lambda(h)+C|Lambda|=sum_x k_(x,h)+sum_<xy> V_xy with k_(x,h)>=1+gamma|q_x|^4 and 0<gamma<g/32.
model.endpoint_energy: e(q)=r*q^2/2+g*q^4/4+r^2/(2*g)>=0 for one force endpoint coordinate.
model.form_domination: For r<0, e(q)<=a_gamma*k_(x,h)+A_r with a_gamma=g/(4*gamma) and A_r=r^2/(2*g), because q^4<=|q_x|^4<=(k_(x,h)-1)/gamma and the quadratic term is nonpositive.
model.fifth_to_third: k_(x,h)>=1 implies k_(x,h)^3<=k_(x,h)^5; the closed R-167 compact-source m5 bounds both endpoints.

scope.not_closed: The bridge supplies only the compact-source local third-moment input. It does not sum Duhamel histories, prove direct D or delta-D Cauchy, establish product/core density, exhaustion independence, group law, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

adversarial_review.check: The source-uniform onsite lower bound is taken from the registered finite-volume form split; no zero-source spectral shift is silently reused.
The coefficient a_gamma=g/(4 gamma) is derived from q^4<=|q_x|^4<=(k-1)/gamma, rather than copied.
r<0 makes r q^2/2 nonpositive, so dropping it is an upper-bound step; the positive shift A_r is retained.
Only the two endpoint onsite moments occur, and the upstream m5 is uniform over registered periodic volumes and compact sources.
k>=1 is used explicitly for k^3<=k^5; no unproved fourth or higher history moment is introduced.
R243 checks only exact rational fixture identities and the scope firewall, not unbounded-operator domains.
A static Gibbs moment is not an all-time direct D,delta-D Cauchy estimate or a history summation.
The bridge is a finite QFT-facing endpoint input; it supplies neither OS/KMS/GNS closure nor heat_root_incidence or the A1/R-192 production owner.

qft_interface.closed: Within the registered periodic compact-source family, the endpoint cubic energy moment needed by the local Q3 force is bounded by a finite explicit function of the already closed onsite fifth moment.
qft_interface.open: Direct all-time projected D and delta-D Cauchy, history summation, exhaustion independence, group law, common alpha, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This is a finite QFT endpoint bridge only; no canonical TECT production map or heat_root_incidence owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing compact-source endpoint third-moment bridge. It is a prerequisite for a two-sided Duhamel remainder estimate, not that estimate itself.
next_action: Insert M_bridge_compact into a genuinely two-sided direct Duhamel remainder estimate on the predeclared fixed-beta OS mixture word class, and test whether the remaining product/core and modular topology inputs can be proved without a forbidden point-norm shortcut.
